title: Junior Strong Full Stack JS Developer
description:
CodeGeeks Solutions is a software company led by top-notch experts with over 10 years of experience in product design & software development. We are able to comprehensively cover the needs of our clients and focus on the full cycle of development.

Now we are looking for an ambitious Junior Strong Full Stack JS Developer in Lviv to join our team!

Why us?
We trust our team and care deeply that everyone feels comfortable and supported in their work and our positive atmosphere
This work will be fulfilling! You’ll develop and acquire new skills, and we’ll support you every step of the way
Here you will find like-minded people and true friends
Here, you’ll even look forward to Mondays!
We’re a young and successful team! :)

We Offer
15 days of annual time off paid + company-wide New Year holiday in the last week of the year (5 days);
20 days of sick leave paid (5 — 100%, 15 — 50%);
Legal support;
IT Cluster membership;
Flexible work schedule and remote work options;
Chance to make a real impact and shape the future of our company;
Education compensation;
Clear career map, continued professional development and growth opportunities;
Opportunity to work with a talented and dynamic team of experts;
Internal training and meetups;
Access to corporate learning materials;
High-level compensation and regular performance-based salary and career development reviews;
PE accounting and support;
Work in a comfortable, modern and cozy office in Lviv;
Team buildings & corporate events;
Referral program.

Requirements
At least 2 years of commercial experience.
English: Upper-Intermediate.
Technical Education.
Located in Lviv with the opportunity to visit the office.
Strong frontend experience with React, NextJS, or similar modern frameworks.
Backend development experience with NodeJS/NestJS, or other modern backend technologies.
Good knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases.
Proficient with AI and agentic coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar.
Strong programming fundamentals and ability to quickly work with new languages, frameworks, and existing codebases.
Experience with TypeScript or other strongly typed languages and GIT.
Good understanding of REST principles and how to design and develop RESTful APIs.
Basic knowledge of Cloud technologies, such as AWS or Azure, is preferred.
Ability to write high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Good problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in a team.
Experience with agile methodologies and software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using appropriate frontend and backend technologies.
Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services.
Design and maintain relational and NoSQL databases.
Use AI coding agents as part of the development workflow for implementation, debugging, refactoring, and testing.
Review and validate AI-generated code, maintaining responsibility for architecture, quality, security, and performance.
Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Troubleshoot and debug issues as they arise.
Continuously improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of applications.

At CodeGeeks, we’re dedicated to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence. If you’re passionate about driving business growth and creating value for our clients, we are waiting for your resume!
